Hero_Desc_Ashur:
The owner of the best bakery in Sprite Kingdom and the worst Magic School headmistress.
If you don't want to hear an outburst of emotions, it's best to not talk about the bakery.
Album_Like_Ashur: Ancient magic books. Her magic school.
Album_Wish_Ashur: Becoming a magic instructor for Trickahn Academy.
Album_Ashur1: Ashur is the 'self-proclaimed' top authority on sprite magic. She established the Magic School and appointed herself as the headmistress... However, managing the school's finances seems more challenging than expected.
Album_Ashur2: Ashur seems to take immense pride in magic. Other sprites rather frequently say Ashur is more talented at baking than in magic, which provokes a very passionate response from Ashur every time.
Album_Ashur3: Having tasted the baked goods Ashur made, I was amazed! It is unlike any baked good I've ever tasted. Of course, coming from a different dimension, that's to be expected...
Album_Ashur4: Tasting it made me understand why they say Ashur might have more talent in baking than in magic. This is also a real talent, so I wonder why Ashur feels the need to be embarrassed about it.
Album_Ashur5: Ashur dreams of being recognized as the 'expert on magic.' However, since magic is common as air in Elias Forest, it's shame not everyone sees it as something special.
Album_Ashur6: Perhaps Ashur is so nice to me because I'm a stranger, unfamiliar with magic? I'm still amazed when Ashur shows me even the simplest of magic tricks. It makes sense that I can't help but be fascinated...
Album_Ashur7: I once suggested to Ashur that combining baking and magic might lead to something interesting. The moment she clenched her fist, I could feel a chilling bloodlust, so I quickly took my words back. Still, it seems my words got to her. I've noticed her practicing something with baked goods late at night. I'm curious to see what kind of results she'll eventually produce.
LoveHero_Ashur:
Are you doing this
just because you
want baked goods?
LoveHeroCancel_Ashur:
That's pretty gutting...
But now I can
focus more on my magic school.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Hate1: Ashur called this food evil. I'm concerned about whether her teeth are okay.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Hate2: When Ashur saw this dish, she gave an unbiased assessment, saying that she could make a tastier melon bread if I gave the melon to her.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like1:
Ashur liked it, saying the food was like the stuff she used to pop fistfuls into her mouth when she was busy. 
That seems to be some sort of soul food that helped her through hard times.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like2: When Ashur ate the fried carrots, she was happy they were on the menu, saying they were a nice alternative for the days she was tired of popcorn.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like3: Ashur bought it in bulk, thinking it would be a good topping on the new baked good she developed.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like4: Saying it's a new type of food, she asked me how to prepare this, eager to learn the recipe.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like5: Ashur asked if this could be mixed into pastry cream.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like6: Ashur got momentarily angry saying it was tastier than anything from her own bakery, then asked for another piece.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like7: Ashur liked the chewy texture and gobbled it up. I guess it's a compliment in her own style.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like8: After one bite, Ashur nodded thinking it would be great as decoration on the new chocolate cake she's making.
Food_ChefNote_Ashur_Like9: Ashur brags that it's her masterpiece. She got the idea from a random box, which is a bit odd, but everyone seems to like it...
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Ashur: Don't call me a bakery owner!

The greatest archwizard of the sprites,
Ashur, is on her way!

Ashur_Spawn1: Best of the sprites, Archmage Ashur is on the move!

Ashur_Growth2: If I grow greater, surely I will gain more students.

Ashur_Defeat2: I could have covered the loss...!
Ashur_Affinity1_1: Don't call me the bakery lady, call me Wizard!
Ashur_Affinity1_2: You want to talk to me without even reading a paper on magical systems?
Ashur_Affinity2: What? You want me to conjure refreshments? Look elsewhere for that!
Ashur_Affinity1_3: Don't just look for me at meal time, call me for adventures too!
Ashur_Affinity3: Again, the Queen has ordered 300 cakes...
Ashur_Affinity4: My magic classroom is right in front of the kitchen counter! Feel free to drop by anytime!
Ashur_Affinity5: The basics of magic are a about all-purpose flour and strong flour... NOT!
Ashur_Affinity6: Baking is all about gravity magic and necromancy... NOT!
Ashur_Affinity7: No one will read my magical theory book... Would you like to read it, Master?
Ashur_Die: I haven't even finished paying rent yet...
Ashur_Die1: I haven't even finished paying rent yet...
Ashur_Die2: I'm still not good at combat magic...
Ashur_HeroSkill: I finished my magic research thesis!
Ashur_HeroUpgrade: Does this mean I'm a chancellor now?
Ashur_Board: A step forward for the field of magic!
Ashur_DeckSetting1: I think I'm more than qualified for this role!
Ashur_Stage: A perfect chance to gain field experience!
Ashur_Touch1_1: As if life wasn't already hard enough!
Ashur_Touch1_2: Oh... Looks like I've grown numb to this pain...
Ashur_Touch2_2: At least things are a bit better now.
Ashur_DutchRubEnd2: Ack! I won't share my baked goods with you anymore!

Ashur_Growth1_Skin1: Perhaps I should earn a degree in the theoretical principles of swimming.
Ashur_Growth2_Skin1: I cannot give up either swimming or magic!
Ashur_LevelUp_Skin1: The more degrees and certificates you have, the better!
Ashur_Equipment_Skin1: Professional swimming gear? I'll put it to good use!
Ashur_HeroSkill_Skin1: I knew it, theory is important for swimming too!
Ashur_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I think I could open a swimming school, hmm?
Ashur_Board_Skin1: I'll swim faster than anyone else!
Ashur_Touch1_Skin1: I'll splash you and have my revenge!
Ashur_Touch1_1_Skin1: Watch it, my sunscreen will wash off!
Ashur_Touch1_2_Skin1: I'm only letting you off because it feels good!
Ashur_Touch2_Skin1: Umm, please don't touch the sunglasses.
Ashur_Touch2_1_Skin1: This is what vacation is all about...!
Ashur_Touch2_2_Skin1: Want me to teach you how to swim?
Ashur_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: I almost dropped my ice cream!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Ashur_Skin2: With both her wallet and her heart feeling full, Ashur seems to have taken up relaxing vacations in search of happiness and stability.
Ashur_Growth1_Skin2: Rest is also nourishment for growth.
Ashur_Growth2_Skin2: Shall we research some fatigue-recovery magic?
Ashur_LevelUp_Skin2: I am studying hot spring science.
Ashur_Equipment_Skin2: Is this necessary for enjoying a hot spring?
Ashur_HeroSkill_Skin2: Perhaps resting is helping me grasp a clue for my research~
Ashur_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: A thorough rest restored my energy!
Ashur_Board_Skin2: Would you like to take a walk over there?
Ashur_Touch1_Skin2: I was resting peacefully, and now this?!
Ashur_Touch1_2_Skin2: Warm and soft? What of it?!
Ashur_Touch2_1_Skin2: I-it might feel a little nice... Hmph!
Ashur_Touch2_2_Skin2: Mmm~ Perhaps you may continue a little longer...
Ashur_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: Would you like to be drenched in warm water?!
Ashur_AsideGet: Brilliant magical theories are flooding into my mind! Maybe I should compile all my knowledge into... the ultimate spellbook?
Ashur_AsideUpgrade: What theorems should I include in the spellbook...? Oh! Please pet me a little more! I just came up with a great equation!
Ashur_SkillCast: Remember this! This is the temperature at which bread is baked!
Ashur_Ultimate1: Bread is baked at this temperature!
Ashur_Ultimate1-01: Bread is baked at this temperature!
Ashur_Birthday: It is your birthday, Master, correct? Shall I make you a cake?
Ashur_Gacha2: The greatest Fairy! Grand Magician Ashur is coming!
Ashur_Gacha3: Do not call me a bakery owner!
Ashur_Line1: Why does nobody want to attend my lectures?
Ashur_Line2: How will I cover this month's rent?
Ashur_Line3: What should my next paper be about?
LoveLetter_Ashur: Greetings, Master. Well, this is awkward... writing to you.Thank you for putting up with all my nagging up until now. I did it for you, though, you get that, right? You're not Her Majesty, so I think you understand.Hmm... Actually, this is not why I'm writing. I've baked something new, and it turned out pretty tasty. Please give it a taste and let me know what you think.
LoveCall_Ashur:
Oh, Master~! You answered sooner than I expected.
What is it? Oh, right! I developed a new recipe. Would you like to come taste it?
This time, I really made something delicious.
It is not just sweet. Following your advice, Master, I made it sweet and tart~
I am truly confident about this one.

The moment I made it and took one little bite, you came to mind.
I am sure you will love it too, Master.
Ah! Her Majesty will be arriving soon. You had better get here before she does, all right?
Then I will see you in a little while!
Affinity_Ashur_EP01_001: Master! How could you open a competing business right next to mine?! You'll drive me out of business!
Affinity_Ashur_EP01_002: If this is enough to put you out of business, you never had a chance to begin with...
Affinity_Ashur_EP01_003: Oh, come on! You know how things are! How can I compete with you when you're giving away free meals?!
Affinity_Ashur_EP01_004: Haven't your profits increased now that those problematic customer visits us instead?
Affinity_Ashur_EP01_005:
You mean Her Majesty? She comes here, but she also comes to my shop too!
The only thing that's changed is that she's just eating more!
Affinity_Ashur_EP01_006: I didn't open this place to compete with you... It was for a good cause...
Affinity_Ashur_EP01_007:
If it's for a good cause, why not give me a cut too?
Be honest, how much do you make? Let me get a cut of the street tax...
Affinity_Ashur_EP02_001: I didn't know you could cook too... Where did you learn it?
Affinity_Ashur_EP02_002: I've learned while having to live on my own.
Affinity_Ashur_EP02_003: Hmm... yes... You'll definitely learn to cook if you're cooking to feed yourself.
Affinity_Ashur_EP02_004: I actually had a bit of professional training.
Affinity_Ashur_EP02_005: Really? Could you teach me a bit, then?
Affinity_Ashur_EP02_006: I just throw some stuff together.
Affinity_Ashur_EP02_007: That explains those things you have on the menu...
Affinity_Ashur_EP03_001: Master! Could you give me a discount on the rent for my magic school this month?
Affinity_Ashur_EP03_002: Why are you asking me that...?
Affinity_Ashur_EP03_003: Well, the building is apparently owned by the Order... Aren't you the actual owner?
Affinity_Ashur_EP03_004: I'll kick you out if you don't pay up in full this month.
Affinity_Ashur_EP03_005:
Please, O Great One... I beg of you...
I'll pay double next month, so please... just this once...! *Sob!*
Affinity_Ashur_EP03_006: What do I always say to you? Sell baked goods, not magic.
Affinity_Ashur_EP03_007: The bakery is just a side hustle... but I guess there's no choice... *Sob...*
Affinity_Ashur_EP04_001:
Master! I've finally created it!
A special magical energy injection that allows even humans to use magic! Roll up your sleeves, quick!
Affinity_Ashur_EP04_002: Has it been approved by the FDA?
Affinity_Ashur_EP04_003: FD... what? Stop making up weird excuses. If you're scared, it's okay to say you are!
Affinity_Ashur_EP04_004: I'm not sure about this. You go first.
Affinity_Ashur_EP04_005:
I can already use magic, so it won't have any effect!
I told you, this only works on humans!
Affinity_Ashur_EP04_007:
Huh? That's weird. Why are you suddenly growing a finger from the top of your head?
Hang on, where's the antidote... wait, did I forget to make one?
Affinity_Ashur_EP05_001: What is the purpose of life? Do you think we all have a calling in life?
Affinity_Ashur_EP05_002: I don't know about me, but I know what yours is.
Affinity_Ashur_EP05_003: Really? Have you received a revelation or something...? I'll punch you if it has anything to do with baked goods.
Affinity_Ashur_EP05_004: Life... is rife with things to enjoy. That's all that matters.
Affinity_Ashur_EP05_005: Wow, that's a very carefree way to think. Well, I guess you need to live like that sometimes, too.
Affinity_Ashur_EP05_006: Do you really need a purpose? Life is always changing anyway.
Affinity_Ashur_EP05_007: Ohh, that's a good one. I'll put that on the cover of the book I'm writing.
Affinity_Ashur_EP06_001: Sometimes I don't understand the world we live in. There are so many things that don't make any sense.
Affinity_Ashur_EP06_002: I'm glad you're aware of that.
Affinity_Ashur_EP06_003: Are you of the same mind as me, Master? Why don't we write a book together?!
Affinity_Ashur_EP06_005: Like the sheer amount of food Her Majesty's stomach can hold.
Affinity_Ashur_EP06_006: It's better to just accept such things rather than question them.
Affinity_Ashur_EP06_007: If you forsake curiosity like that, it prevents the growth of knowledge and experience!
Affinity_Ashur_EP07_001: Elves know a lot of things. I just wish they put them to use for good causes.
Affinity_Ashur_EP07_002: I think they already put them to good use.
Affinity_Ashur_EP07_003:
I really don't think they do, though...
You didn't really pay attention to what I just said, did you?
Affinity_Ashur_EP07_004: Are you jealous of their high-tech equipment? Do you want me to get you something?
Affinity_Ashur_EP07_005: Oh, really?! Then please buy me one of those stand mixers!
Affinity_Ashur_EP07_006: I'm sure the elves are putting their knowledge to good use in their own way.
Affinity_Ashur_EP07_007: From their perspective, right? Well... I guess everyone has different standards for what's good and bad.
Affinity_Ashur_EP08_001:
Master! Please use the power of your faith to rid the world of magic!
Please make everyone flock to my magic school!
Affinity_Ashur_EP08_002: How can you run a magic school if there's no magic at all?
Affinity_Ashur_EP08_003: Huh? Y-You're right. Then get rid of magic for everyone except me! Waaaaah!!!!
Affinity_Ashur_EP08_004: I'm sorry, but I'm not that kind of Master...
Affinity_Ashur_EP08_005:
How about spiking the food in the banquet hall with poison—I mean medicine?
Dosing with some magic suppressant or something?!
Affinity_Ashur_EP08_006: It's unbecoming to bring up faith for strictly personal desires.
Affinity_Ashur_EP08_007: That's how desperate I am! I gotta pay this month's rent, y'know?!
Affinity_Ashur_EP09_001: Master, let me put up some flyers for my magic school in the banquet hall!
Affinity_Ashur_EP09_003: Soliciting?! How can you say that to a diligent sprite who works hard every day!
Affinity_Ashur_EP09_004: How much are you going to pay for advertising?
Affinity_Ashur_EP09_005: What? You want me to pay? But isn't the banquet hall free? Only the meals are free, you say...? Huh...?
Affinity_Ashur_EP09_006: ...I won't stop you from handing them out at the entrance.
Affinity_Ashur_EP09_007: Thank you! I'll do my best to get new students and pay the rent on time every month!
Affinity_Ashur_EP10_001: I've created some new flame magic! Check it out!
Affinity_Ashur_EP10_002: It's pretty but somewhat plain. The elven fireworks are prettier.
Affinity_Ashur_EP10_003: Dang it, I have to compete with elves with this too...?!
Affinity_Ashur_EP10_004: This time, you got it right. It looks cool!
Affinity_Ashur_EP10_005:
Right? This one will sell for sure!
Why don't you invest in this business? A loan guarantee would be good too...
Affinity_Ashur_EP10_006: You aren't going to set this hall on fire, are you...?
Affinity_Ashur_EP10_007: What a terrible thing to say! That's not what my magic is about!
Affinity_Ashur_EP11_001: What do you think of magic, Master? I thought an outsider's perspective might offer something different.
Affinity_Ashur_EP11_002: A collection of unimpressive Fairy tricks.
Affinity_Ashur_EP11_003: Ugh... Would you like me to make you suffer with one of those unimpressive tricks?
Affinity_Ashur_EP11_004: It seems rather similar to science, only under a different name...
Affinity_Ashur_EP11_005: Right? Perhaps I should enter the Elven city under the banner of magical engineering.
Affinity_Ashur_EP11_006: To me, magic means a farm upstate.
Affinity_Ashur_EP11_007: What...? What are you talking about?
Affinity_Ashur_EP12_001: About the strawberry cake, I think the surface should be baked a little less... Try lowering the temperature.
Affinity_Ashur_EP12_002: Ashur, enough backseat baking. You are going to become a genuine bread fanatic.
Affinity_Ashur_EP12_003: Ugh. Once I notice something, I cannot stop thinking about it.
Affinity_Ashur_EP12_004: I will follow the advice of the finest baker in Elias.
Affinity_Ashur_EP12_005: Hehe! As expected... Wait, I am not a baker?!
Affinity_Ashur_EP12_006: I deliberately make it taste bad because of Erpin.
Affinity_Ashur_EP12_007: What? There was such an excellent solution?!
Affinity_Ashur_EP13_001: I may be struggling in many ways, but not enough to deserve pity. Sigh~ Somehow, a strange rumor has spread.
Affinity_Ashur_EP13_002: So you do not need free food?
Affinity_Ashur_EP13_003: No, I truly have no money. I am completely destitute.
Affinity_Ashur_EP13_004: Take this opportunity to beg your way into an easier life.
Affinity_Ashur_EP13_005: My pride as an intellectual... Sob...
Affinity_Ashur_EP13_006: Do not worry. Erpin will not pity you in the slightest.
Affinity_Ashur_EP13_007: I wish Her Majesty would show me a little pity. You should have seen how much bread she ate today...
Affinity_Ashur_EP14_001: Master, were you ever interested in scholarship or research? I was simply curious.
Affinity_Ashur_EP14_002: I did about as much as everyone else.
Affinity_Ashur_EP14_003: That is the best way to live as an ordinary citizen.
Affinity_Ashur_EP14_004: I was something of an expert in one field.
Affinity_Ashur_EP14_005: I thought so. You resolve nearly every problem in a fairly rational manner.
Affinity_Ashur_EP14_006: I have never read anything longer than three lines.
Affinity_Ashur_EP14_007: Should you not read a little more, if only out of respect for the author's effort?
Affinity_Ashur_EP15_001: I still lose sleep worrying about my future career. Sob.
Affinity_Ashur_EP15_003: You agree, Master? Then would you provide me with some funding?
Affinity_Ashur_EP15_004: Do what you are good at.
Affinity_Ashur_EP15_005: Why did the World Tree grant me a talent for baking...?
Affinity_Ashur_EP15_006: Do not delude yourself into thinking you have a choice.
Affinity_Ashur_EP15_007: I do not want to face reality! Tell me what I want to hear!
Affinity_Ashur_EP16_001: Honestly, am I not rather cultured for a Fairy? I suit your standards quite well too, do I not, Master?
Affinity_Ashur_EP16_002: Indeed. In some respects, you seem more intelligent than I am.
Affinity_Ashur_EP16_003: Honestly, speaking with you feels strangely comfortable, Master.
Affinity_Ashur_EP16_004: No. You also have a screw loose somewhere...
Affinity_Ashur_EP16_005: What part of me seems that way?! There is nothing strange about pursuing a dream!
Affinity_Ashur_EP16_006: In a way. You are somewhat opportunistic and tenacious, though.
Affinity_Ashur_EP16_007: Ugh... Would it be an excuse to say reality made me this way?

Affinity_Ashur_EP17_002: Ashur, this is a pyramid scheme.
Affinity_Ashur_EP17_003: Do you think I do not know that? You have to join these things early, cash out, and get away clean!
Affinity_Ashur_EP17_004: Did Sist talk you into this?
Affinity_Ashur_EP17_005: How did you know? She said she was telling only me!
Affinity_Ashur_EP17_007: Oh? Whom will you bring? Call them quickly! We need to make money!
Affinity_Ashur_EP18_001: I did it! I have been invited to hold a 'magic demonstration' before the Elves~!
Affinity_Ashur_EP18_002: I thought you did not like Elves very much.
Affinity_Ashur_EP18_003: That is when they are competitors. I can love them as customers!
Affinity_Ashur_EP18_004: Congratulations. A strong beginning should lead to further success.
Affinity_Ashur_EP18_005: Right? If I seize this opportunity, I will finally be recognized as an expert!
Affinity_Ashur_EP18_006: Congratulations on the performance, Ashur. Will you be bending spoons?
Affinity_Ashur_EP18_007: What? A performance...? Bending spoons? What do you mean?
Affinity_Ashur_EP19_001: I happened to see an AI robot built by the Elves. Is it truly acceptable to create something like that artificially?
Affinity_Ashur_EP19_002: Magic creates things like golems too.
Affinity_Ashur_EP19_003: Those have extremely low intelligence! But AI is more intelligent than most Fairies!
Affinity_Ashur_EP19_004: Were you not also created by the World Tree?
Affinity_Ashur_EP19_005: Does that give us the right to create someone else?
Affinity_Ashur_EP19_007: What is that? When it arrives, will I no longer have to bake bread?
Affinity_Ashur_EP20_001: Master! I asked you not to let Her Majesty enter the bakery today!
Affinity_Ashur_EP20_002: You know stopping Erpin is impossible.
Affinity_Ashur_EP20_004: She played for ages this morning and then clearly fell asleep.
Affinity_Ashur_EP20_005: Her eyes were closed... Could she have walked here in her sleep, like a sleepwalker?
Affinity_Ashur_EP20_006: ...The banquet hall has already been raided too.
Affinity_Ashur_EP20_007: Sigh~ Do dreams and hope mean nothing before Her Majesty's appetite?
